name: San Diego
registryBasis: SanGIS is the City of San Diego and County of San Diego joint-powers GIS publisher. Its unstacked parcel reference polygon data is publicly served by the county DPW map service; thirteen local query cells returned complete parcel geometries.
scopeLimits: 129 valid, distinct official SanGIS unstacked reference polygons audited in thirteen bounded local cells near the WUP 2025 San Diego settlement locator. All required real-adapter checks passed across recorded attempts with explicit provider-timeout retries. No sampled overlaps above 0.01 m², duplicate geometry or invalid polygons were found. This is bounded San Diego-area source verification, not municipality-wide completeness or legal survey evidence. SanGIS uses one reference polygon per tax parcel; selected APNs may change, so runtime identity uses native PARCELID rather than APN.
remainingUncertainty: Provider deadlines occurred intermittently; whole-city completeness, legal boundary accuracy and APN correspondence are unverified.
